title: Removing the defender
line: Capture or chase the piece that holds everything together.

steps.text: Your queen and bishop both aim at the pawn in front of the black king. Only one black piece keeps them out.
Tap the black piece that guards that pawn.
steps.hint: Look for the piece that could capture on h7.
steps.after: The knight is the only guard.

steps.text: Remove the defender: capture it with your bishop.
steps.after: Black took back, and now nothing guards the pawn in front of the king.

steps.text: Take the pawn with the queen. The bishop behind her guards her.
steps.after: Checkmate. The knight that guarded the pawn is gone.

summary: Find the one piece that guards everything, then capture it or chase it away. What it guarded falls.
